item.title: 'Predatory' Sudanese migrant jailed for trying to kidnap teenage girl walking home at night
item.description: A Sudanese migrant has been jailed for attempting to kidnap a 17-year-old girl as she was walking home from work at night. Abdulmawal Ibrahim Adam, 28, grabbed the teenager before dragging her across the street "against her will", Swindon Crown Court heard. item.description: When thinking of Greek holidays, islands like Santorini, Crete and Mykonos are often the first to spring to mind.
